violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level at the MOP SINK is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE CUT THE HOSE ATTACHMENT AT THE MOP SINK TO BE ABOVE THE FLOOD RIM.
